title: Xenomit — Rollout Progress & Gates
description: docs/06 §6.7 + docs/04 §4.1. Handoff latency, offline window vs the 45 s SLO, restore outcomes, and the exact metrics the rollout gates read.

panels.title: Offline window p95 (SLO ≤ 45 s)
panels.description: xenomit.handoff.offline_window — the user-visible gap during a handoff. Gate: planned-rollout p95 ≤ 45 s (docs/04 §4.4).

panels.title: Handoff duration p95 by reason/quality
panels.description: xenomit.handoff.duration — total handoff wall time including drain wait.

panels.title: Snapshot restores (15m)
panels.description: xenomit.snapshot.restore_total by outcome. Gate maxFailedRestores: 0 — any 'failed' pauses the rollout.

panels.title: Login failure rate (gate ≤ 2%)
panels.description: Failed logins / total logins over 15m. The rollout gate is maxLoginFailureRatePermille=20 — this panel reads the same data (docs/06 §6.6).

panels.title: Gateway FENCED rejections
panels.description: xenomit.gateway.fenced_total — stale-epoch streams refused. A spike during a rollout means two pods claimed one bot.

panels.title: Rewards per hour (regression gate)
panels.description: xenomit.bot.rewards_per_hour by asset/module. Gate minRewardRateRatio=0.7 compares post-rollout rate to the pre-rollout window.
